decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those shown on the approved plans.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted ( Design and Access Statement, 000, 001, 002, 003, 200, 201, 300, 301. Received 23/10/18 ) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - The outbuilding hereby permitted shall be used incidental to the use of 409 Chiswick High Road, London, W4 4AR, and not as a self-contained dwelling unit nor for business purposes, nor shall any kitchen or bedroom(s) be installed in the outbuilding without the permission of the Local Planning Authority obtained through the submission of a planning application.
description: Erection of a detached single storey outbuilding to be used as a garden studio with gym, garden room, changing room and W.C. in the rear garden of the house
